stories.title: Regulars
stories.summary: Amaria runs a small patisserie at the edge of the galaxy, where two infamous wanted men, the Tempest and the Siren, drop in now and then for cakes and drinks. Seen from the counter, they are far gentler than their bounty posters suggest. When a nosy neighbour spots the bounty on the screen, she has to decide where her loyalty lies.

stories.title: Breathe
stories.summary: Jun has a bad feeling about a set of ruins but keeps quiet, as he always does, and follows Frey and Star inside. A creature seizes him in the dark, and Frey throws everything he has into getting to him. Afterwards the two of them talk about what Jun should have said and what Frey needs from him.

stories.title: No place for a hero
stories.summary: Frey lands his ship in the desert biome of a hostile artificial planet, hides it in the sand and tracks Jun's biometric signature past a watering hole to find him. When they meet, Frey admits he is furious with Jun but has missed him too much to care.

stories.title: What breaks the sky?
stories.summary: The party fights an undead roc on a snowfield, with Brian Styles and Star attacking it while Frey holds it down with a spell and Jun ducks in and out of a snow hole. Hidden archers in furs join in, and an arrow strikes Frey just as Jun's wild magic goes off. A shockwave from the roc leaves Jun lying still on the ice.

stories.title: So much better
stories.summary: After Jun is bitten, he and Frey cling to the hope that he might be immune. Frey is chained to a wall with his arms stretched overhead as Jun's condition worsens and Jun grows terrified of what he will do to Frey. Frey tries to comfort him as they wait to find out what happens.

stories.title: Mourning Tomorrow
stories.summary: Back in Saltmarsh two months after a week in the fey realm, Jun, Frey, Brian Styles and Star meet up with Eddie at the Wicker Goat. Frey retells their adventures, including the Deer Lord's warning that Jun is hunted by a goddess who wants the necklace he carries. Jun sits quietly in the warmth of the table and weighs whether to slip away alone to keep the others safe, or whether he can bear to leave.

stories.title: Threads
stories.summary: In the Rokoss mountains, Frey wakes to find that nobody in the party remembers Jun, and every trace of him is gone. Rayra, the shaman's helper, offers a deal: Frey can pass through an ancient barrier and search the realms behind it for the real Jun, or be stuck there forever. Frey wakes in one world after another, each with a different Jun and a different version of himself, among them a spaceship, a vampire's bed, a ruined kingdom of undead and a court where he is king. Each one brings new dangers and new truths about how he feels about Jun.

stories.title: Fictions we took to mean Fate
stories.summary: On a snowy mountain climb, Jun confronts Frey about stepping in front of him during a troll encounter on a bridge. The scene plays twice, first from Frey's side and then Jun's. Each hides his real feelings, and Frey's careless, mocking answer leaves both hurt.

source.name: Fictions we took to mean Fate

stories.title: Like you need it
stories.summary: Jun, a captured hunter pinned and weaponless, is at the mercy of a vampire who turns out to be Frey. Frey bites him, and Jun's fear mixes with an unwelcome craving for more. Explicit.

stories.title: All blame is due
stories.summary: Jun hurries through a mine tunnel after Star, who has run ahead with Brian Styles, the polymorphed duck. Frey saunters behind and refuses to speed up. When the polymorph spell suddenly snaps, Jun fears the worst and makes a hard choice, leaving Frey behind.

stories.title: The sky he never saw
stories.summary: Frey takes Jun, and only Jun, back to the abandoned mine where he was held as a child. Just inside the entrance is a small cairn that marks the grave of someone he lost there. Jun stays beside him while Frey does something he has never done for anyone, and then the two of them step out under the open sky.

stories.title: Like you never had wings
stories.summary: Bored on solo nav watch, Frey cannot resist opening the sealed box the crew has been paid handsomely to deliver, and a malevolent spirit takes over his body while he watches helplessly from inside. It poses as Frey to get close to Jun, who is in the early days of a slow romance with him, and Jun realises something is wrong. The rest of the crew, Star, Fizzy and Brian Styles, are slow to catch on, and the aftermath leaves Jun and Frey to deal with what was done. Contains graphic violence and sexual assault.

stories.title: Party Party
stories.summary: At a party, Frey introduces Jun, a vampire hunter, to the world of the high table families, and Jun learns something about the Brightburns that shocks him. Frey leaves him alone in a room full of strangers to go and greet Fizzy Brightburn. Jun heads for the drinks table to show he can enjoy himself too, and Frey notices who he is talking to.

stories.title: Ghosts
stories.summary: Frey dreams of fleeing a bodak through the crystal mines where he was once enslaved, and fights back with a pick. He wakes in his cabin to find Jun slumped against the wall with Frey's own knife in his chest. Frey frantically tries to keep him conscious while Jun, in shock, can't heal himself, and calls Fizzy for help.

stories.title: Hold the hand of the God-child
stories.summary: While helping the svirfneblin against slavers, Jun and Frey are attacked by a monstrous Beaverdile. Jun takes mammoth form to protect Frey and is swallowed. He escapes with a teleport spell, but the magic misfires and drops him back into a place he hoped never to see again, one tied to the goddess who held him when he was dead. When he reappears in the fortress, he finds Frey frantic.

source.name: Hold the hand of the God-child

stories.title: Panic
stories.summary: Frey and Jun are in a dark mine tunnel when Jun suddenly speeds ahead and disappears. Alone in the dark, Frey calls after him and is pulled into memories of being locked away in places like this. The story stays with Frey as the panic builds.

stories.title: Revelations
stories.summary: Fizzy and Star put on a dramatic scene, announcing to Frey that he has discovered their secret relationship. Jun and Frey watch as the pair leave the room, and Frey wonders whether it is real. Jun has a dry answer for him.

stories.title: Telling Eddie
stories.summary: Frey stalls in the street outside Eddie's market stall, nervous about telling his oldest friend that he and Jun are together. Jun reminds him that Eddie is probably not as clueless as Frey hopes. They walk up to the stall together and Frey finally says it.

stories.title: Ashes to Ashes
stories.summary: Frey, worn out and haunted by his childhood in a mine, refuses to sleep while the group frees svirfneblin slaves in the Underdark, until exhaustion takes him. A nightmare of chains, his old overseer and his mother follows, and Jun enters the dream through his cloak and finds him afterwards. Jun offers a quiet account of his own mother's death.

stories.title: Take our hands, let's fly away
stories.summary: Sitting on the edge of a bed, Jun tells Frey he thinks he loves him, then stumbles to explain that he has never known this kind of love before. He lists the small ways Frey has become his home, and Frey has a confession of his own.

source.name: Take our hands, let's fly away

stories.title: Home
stories.summary: Jun returns to The Leviathan after a week helping Gorgi through calving season, to a boisterous welcome from the crew and a warmer one from Frey. A messy family meal gives way to a quiet, affectionate night alone together in Jun's quarters. Explicit.

stories.title: His Own Trick
stories.summary: Four days after a late night talk at the tavern, Jun notices Frey has been acting as though nothing happened, just louder and quicker with his jokes. By the evening fire, Jun decides to try Frey's own flirting on him. Frey, who prides himself on being immune to it, quickly loses his composure.

stories.title: I will stay
stories.summary: Five times on the Leviathan, Frey comforts Jun and talks him down: after he spots the mayor who took his home at a diplomatic banquet, when a botched job leaves him shot, after a nightmare of his parents, when he realises how long he will outlive everyone, and when he holds a mammoth shape through a blizzard. In a sixth scene Jun finally returns the favour when Frey is overwhelmed in a crowded spaceport. A second part follows the two of them captured by slavers with Jun's magic suppressed, while Star, Fizzy and Brian Styles mount a rescue.

stories.title: Ruins
stories.summary: Frey falls asleep on cold stone and dreams of his mother in a sunlit meadow, until the dream turns dark and then turns on Jun too. Frey ends up trapped in a nightmare version of the mine where he was held. A voice that is really Jun's reaches him there, and the two of them talk about the things Frey never says.

stories.title: A Proper Date
stories.summary: Frey insists that after more than a year together he and Jun have never been on a proper date, and he arranges one for sundown at the harbor. He turns up dressed up with a hired skiff, lanterns and a basket of food that includes peaches. Out on the calm water the two of them eat, talk and watch the stars.

stories.title: In the dead of night
stories.summary: Jun, Frey, Star and Brian Styles return to the inn after a night out in the snow, and Jun finds that Star's cheapness has left him sharing a room with Frey. There is only one bed, and the two circle around who sleeps where, with Jun flustered and Frey teasing. It ends as Jun gets under the covers.

stories.title: Cause some Drama
stories.summary: Loke, an overworked head of the Imperium police force, is buried in endless reports when Jun slips into his office. Jun, the most wanted man in the universe, has come to give himself up so that the crew stops being in danger, and asks Loke to take Fizzy's crimes onto him and look after the others. Loke agrees to do what he can and leads him out in cuffs.

stories.title: For all the Ghosts
stories.summary: Jun is working for the cruel Ruohan to raise the money to rebuild Brian Styles, and he is hollowed out by the killing the work demands. After a massacre at a camp, he sits shaking in his shuttle, hiding how he really feels from Fizzy. In the months since the explosion, Frey and Star have been lost to him, and he holds onto a fading picture of Frey and a promise to find him.

stories.title: Kick at the Darkness
stories.summary: Aboard the spaceship The Leviathan, pirates try to take the vessel while Jun holds layered buffs over the heavy hitters Brian Styles and Star. When Frey is shot shielding him, Jun must choose between keeping his allies protected and saving the man he realises he loves, and he reaches for a costly kind of magic.

stories.title: The brink of the day
stories.summary: On a rain-soaked station landing bay littered with the bodies of bounty hunters, Jun, now the Tempest, is ready to kill whoever comes next. Frey begs him to stop and reminds him of the farm and the life he promised him. The two confront whether Jun can set the Tempest aside and choose to live.

stories.title: VampireBoys - Skirrin Encounter
stories.summary: Frey and Jun wake shackled in a dungeon belonging to Skirrin, an older vampire with a grudge against Frey. Skirrin makes Jun the instrument of his revenge while Frey is forced to watch. Once Skirrin leaves, Frey has to work out how to break the chains and get Jun out alive.

stories.title: Death Do Us Part
stories.summary: Frey and Jun marry on the Saltmarsh harbor, with lanterns, wildflowers and Eddie handing over the rings. Three days later a fight on the road shows that the rings link them, so that Frey feels the blows Jun takes. In a second part, called The Distance Between, cultists who know about the rings split the pair up and drag Frey further and further from Jun while hurting Jun below ground.

stories.title: It's you
stories.summary: During the Saltmarsh campaign, an ice storm and elementals hit the merchant ships the heroes are escorting, and Jun tries to save as many dying people as he can while the stern sinks. Healing under water with a limited supply of air, he makes a desperate choice to help one woman, and Frey turns up in the flooded wreck.

stories.title: Blue
stories.summary: Jun sits Frey down to talk about something he has long avoided: he is a drow whose cobalt blue skin comes from a wild magic surge, which turned out to be a permanent curse. Moved by how openly Frey owns his own heritage, Jun says he is thinking of letting the curse go and asks what Frey thinks.

stories.title: Smooch
stories.summary: In a vampire hunter story, Jun is cornered by a white-haired vampire, Frey, who brushes his fangs against Jun's neck but does not bite. Jun, who hunts vampires for a living, breaks free and puts a dagger to Frey's throat. The moment turns into something neither of them expected.

stories.title: Not with a bang, but with a whimper
stories.summary: Frey and Jun, a famous and feared pair of outlaws, dream of a quiet future with a house, a garden and a goat. Instead Frey is diagnosed with a cancer that even Jun's healing magic cannot touch, and Jun grows more desperate and reckless as they chase every possible cure across the galaxy. Frey is the calmer one, and when the Imperial fleet finally closes in he has to decide what he wants from the end.

source.name: Not with a bang, but with a whimper

stories.title: Show me what you're betting
stories.summary: In a dystopian city where Guardians and Enforcers police emotion and punish dissent with reconditioning, Yunho and Jongho work undercover as police for Hongjoong's underground resistance crew. Wooyoung and San have secretly been running fixed underground fights to raise money, and a bout goes badly wrong, leaving San hospitalised and shackled. The team has to plan a risky hospital rescue while San, awake and alone, tries to get out on his own. Told across several viewpoints and four chapters.

stories.title: What I'm Running From
stories.summary: Two days after the fight with the Beavercrocodile, Frey plays lute in a loud tavern while Jun watches from a corner table. Late at night, drunk and quiet inside for the first time in a while, Frey starts to talk to Jun about what he is running from and the sister he lost. Jun stays beside him and listens.

stories.title: Bleeding Magic
stories.summary: The crew fights through crumbling ruins and a horde of cultists while Jun struggles to hold back the dark power of a cursed idol. Star carries him, Fizzy clears the way with grenades, and Frey cuts through the fanatics, all racing for an anti-magic pedestal. When the idol is finally contained, something has happened to Jun, and Frey tries desperately to reach him.

stories.title: Choices
stories.summary: During a fight to free gnome slaves from dwarves, Jun and Frey operate a tank together and move almost as one. When a dwarf takes a gnome hostage and Jun makes a ruthless call, Frey suddenly vanishes from the tank and leaves Jun alone, wounded and fighting two dwarves inside the cramped hull. Hurt and feeling abandoned, Jun decides on a drastic use of his magic.

stories.title: Cause if your friends don't dance
stories.summary: In the rebuilt New Snapping Line pub, Frey plays lute on a table while Jun sits alone in the corner, and Frey gets him onto the floor despite Jun saying he cannot dance. Later, drunk and tired, Frey walks home with Jun through Saltmarsh at night. On the way he says what he likes about the town and about Jun.

source.name: Cause if your friends don't dance

stories.title: Of all the lives I could have had, I'd want to spend them with you
stories.summary: Jun and Frey are reborn across countless lives and universes, always finding each other and remembering what they mean to one another, whether as a barista and a stray cat, a prince and a servant, or a vampire and a hunter. They test theories about why it keeps happening and fall into patterns of sacrificing for each other. The story moves between their many lives and ends on one that ran its full course.

source.name: Of all the lives I could have had, I'd want to spend them with you

stories.title: Let's not change the World, but make another one
stories.summary: Frey has a run of small disasters aboard the Leviathan, from deleted star-routes to a torn flightsuit and a failed cargo bay. Jun, his lover, notices his mood when he trudges back to their quarters and sets out to cheer him up with a holographic night sky. The two spend the evening together under the projected stars.

source.name: Let's not change the World, but make another one

stories.title: Turn back the tide
stories.summary: Back on the ship after a near miss, Frey chatters about repairs and shore leave while Jun stays silent by the door. Jun is carrying a thirty million credit bounty on his head and has decided the crew is only safe if he does something drastic. Frey, who only just got him back, argues against it.

stories.title: Spaceboyband
stories.summary: The crew of the Starling pose as a band called the Sparrows to get into an invitation-only venue and steal some Books, with Frey as lead singer, Star talked into it, and Jun, Fizzy and Brian Styles learning their instruments. The shows pay so well that Star agrees to six, and Jun gradually finds he loves the stage and singing beside Frey, while the crew discovers fan fiction written about them. Fame has a cost, with a frightening encounter at the stage door and a last show that goes badly wrong.

stories.title: The Sweet Hereafter
stories.summary: At a busy market Jun secretly looks for a citrus-scented gift to cheer up Frey, who has been low lately. A knowing halfling shopkeeper sells him a special soap, and Jun spirals over what giving it might imply until Fizzy finds him. Someone watches them from the shadows as they leave.

stories.title: What Happened
stories.summary: Back with the crew after being presumed dead, Frey hears from Fizzy what happened to the others while he was gone: the ship's destruction, the search, and the years of hard work that followed. She tells him that Jun has changed and that people now fear him as the Tempest. Frey then meets a warm Jun, who is just as he remembered, and struggles to reconcile the two.

stories.title: Redemption Lies Plainly
stories.summary: Jun and Frey, married, run a farm and cafe where a runaway goat, home-grown tea and shared fruit fill a warm, funny day. Frey is happy to have swapped cots and recycled air for soft beds and fresh bread. The story then turns, as Frey wakes somewhere much colder and lonelier and a news bulletin about the Tempest shows what has really happened.

stories.title: GOOGOO FOR GOGGLES
stories.summary: Jun, a blue elf with a secret dark elf heritage, is nervous about travelling to the Rokkoss mountains to help Star, since bright light and snow glare make his eyes hurt. While Frey takes him shopping for a coat, Jun spots a pair of enchanted dark-glass goggles and, with no gold of his own, has to decide what he is willing to trade for them.

stories.title: Nightmares
stories.summary: Self-described sickfic set on the Leviathan. The crew is hired to deliver crates of vaccine and medicine for the Nightmare Sickness, a once-in-a-lifetime fever that causes waking nightmares, to the mining planet Franklin, where an outbreak has hit. Jun, Frey and Brian Styles argue in the hold about the cargo's huge value and the hazard pay, and Frey says he already had the illness as a child in the mines. The fragment breaks off before landing.

stories.title: Choices Bside
stories.summary: Frey and Jun are in a mine with a tank when a gnome is struck down by a pickaxe. Frey turns invisible and leaves the tank and Jun's side, pulled by memories of his own past. He runs to the gnome's body to try to save him.

stories.title: Lemon Tree
stories.summary: Deep in fungus-choked tunnels on the way to infiltrate a giants' camp, Jun trails behind Star, Frey and their new companion Mrs O. He reflects on the chaos of recent days, including losing Fizzy and a vision of his late mother from a pool, until Frey demands to know what he saw.

stories.title: Caution to the Wind
stories.summary: Frey has been backing Jun's increasingly extreme plans, including one Star openly objects to, and stays quiet about his own doubts. In their quarters Jun notices and presses him, and Frey admits the fear underneath, that he is no longer needed and Jun might leave. Frey is frail and uses a cane after what he has been through, which feeds the worry.

stories.title: Jealous much
stories.summary: Jun heads to his interrogation room on the ship, planning to question a kidnapped politician he has been working on for hours. He meets Frey coming out, and the room behind him is covered in blood. Frey explains why, and Jun finds he cannot stay annoyed.

stories.title: Into the Feywild
stories.summary: Jun, a sorcerer haunted by deaths his magic has caused, trails behind his party as a centaur leads them deep into the Feywild. Terrified of the place his power comes from and of the word "destined", he hides his distress until the tiefling bard Frey, newly joined to the group, catches his eye and does something reckless that pulls Jun out of his spiral.
